verdict.rationale: Fern documents a local preview server with hot reload. It also says it 'offers two ways to preview documentation changes', which implies a second preview mechanism, but the evidence never says what that mechanism is. A local server is not shareable and is not tied to pull requests, so only a glancing part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: shareable hosted preview URLs, automatic preview deployment on every docs pull request (CI/GitHub integration), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
